blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The Batangas Police Provincial Office (BPPO) filed a murder complaint on Oct. 21 against eight suspects in the killing of village chief Dennis Austria in Sto. Tomas City, Batangas. Police said the suspects were implicated in Austria’s killing at his residence in Barangay Sta. Anastacia on Oct. 15. On Oct. 20, police arrested the alleged driver of the motorcycle used in the getaway at around 12:05 a.m. in Barangay Balagtasin, San Jose town, Batangas.
